title: Add localStorage error handling to prevent silent data loss
description: The value-stream-store uses Zustand persist middleware with localStorage but has no error handling for QuotaExceededError or other storage failures. When localStorage quota is exceeded (5MB limit across all origins), setItem silently fails or throws an unhandled DOMException, causing data loss without user notification. Fix: Add a custom storage adapter to the persist middleware that wraps setItem in try/catch, shows a user-visible toast/notification on failure, and optionally calculates remaining quota before writes. Reference: Zustand persist middleware supports custom storage implementations. Also consider adding a data size indicator somewhere so users know if they're approaching limits.
